Container.Name: Homebase-Hub
Container.Overview: Your own start page and personal hub: links, notes, cards, tasks, encrypted files and more than 100 tools that run in your browser. One password, your data stays on your server. After the first start open the web page, click the key icon, and get the setup code from site-data/core/SETUP-CODE.php in the app's folder. Update it in the site itself: Settings, Updates (a newer image never replaces a site that is already there).

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: The port you open the site on. For HTTPS (passkeys, phone install) put a reverse proxy such as Nginx Proxy Manager or SWAG in front.

Config.Name: Site and data
Config.Description: The site and your data (site-data). The first start copies the site in when the folder is empty. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy
Config.Description: Only with a reverse proxy in front: its address (for example 172.17.0.1), so the site sees each visitor's address and HTTPS. Leave empty otherwise.
